rationale.provenance-auditability: Persistent attestations, dependency digests, and signing logs enable human audits.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Human security review is an authoritative pre-release certification checkpoint.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Mandates static analysis, sandbox validation, provenance checks, and compiler gates.
rationale.formal-methods: Integrates selective formal reasoning and machine-checkable contracts into certification tiers.
rationale.org-governance: Defines certification teams, assurance tiers, multi-party review, and repository governance.
